overall_reason: The idea is 'each deploy is one traceable row': status icon, status word, branch, commit hash, author and age, with one 'Deploy' action.

score.reason: T-ONE-SENTENCE, T-SIGNATURE and T-BOLD-MOVE pass; the row metadata is clipped at both widths, and T-RIVAL-NAME holds for any deploy tool.

findings.title: App screens disappear into the task
findings.evidence: In tiles/1440-00.png the second row's meta ends 'perf/search · b41e09d · J' and the third ends '· Ana'; the DOM text continues 'Jon Park · 42s' and 'Ana Ruiz · 42s'. The author and build time are cut.
findings.before: Clipped author names and hidden build durations.
findings.after: Let the meta line wrap or drop the duration to a second column so the author shows in full.
findings.why: The details that make the row traceable are the ones cut off.

strengths: Status is stated three ways per row: icon, coloured word ('Live', 'Building', 'Failed') and age.
Branch and short commit hash ('main · 8f2c1a4') make each deploy specific.
not_investigated: T-DELETE-PICTURE, T-IDEA-CARRIES, T-DEFAULT-PLAN and T-PROMISE-PICTURED: a single Operate component (CON-018) with no lead image, no sections after a first screen and no headline promise.
00-contract.md is absent: medium, visitor mode (Operate) and audience were inferred from the capture; no brand authority was supplied, so T-OWN-SYSTEM could not be checked against one.
Motion and state changes: one static frame per width only.
